scope: Local OSCQuery WebSocket commands for Golden managers, editable node metadata and document history

verified: A real WebSocket client uses the published catalog to create items and reads their committed addresses over HTTP
Renaming, enablement, tags, description, color and collapse use workbench intents and support clearing overrides
Reordering before a sibling, removal, remote Undo and Redo, and local Undo of a remote move use the same document history
Unknown catalog types, unauthorized removal and rename, ownership metadata and invalid insertion anchors are rejected
The actor rejects a stale metadata patch after a competing edit, and disabling OSCQuery closes an open WebSocket

bundledMapGyver.screen: Created, renamed, recolored, removed and restored using the same history as local Undo

remaining: Client-specific LISTEN and rate-limited feedback bundles, including isolation and burst verification
Copy OSC Address in node menus and the Interface preference for OSC addresses in Help
